findings.claim: The three-stage structure of narrative organisation: an opening equilibrium, a disruption, and a resolution or new equilibrium.
findings.truth: The three-act structure is conventionally setup, confrontation and resolution. Equilibrium, disruption and a new equilibrium is a simplified account of Todorov’s model, not the three-act structure.
findings.evidence: Three-act structure, fetched Wikipedia source, defines the acts as setup, confrontation and resolution; the lesson’s own later Todorov discussion distinguishes the models.

findings.claim: The extended-writing question on the US independent film includes a source of specialist writing … The actual sources rotate every three years
